initial_structure.public_exposure: none (coordinate-free: public/ holds only system.json; the agent generates its own coordinates)
initial_structure.source: PACKMOL random fill (unrelaxed; close contacts present)
initial_structure.reason_to_geopt_first: PACKMOL structure into AIMD directly is unstable (close contacts); expert ran GEO_OPT first

aimd.filter: step-0 removal + duplicate-step removal + 250-350 K temperature window
aimd.hidden_validation_role: the 190-frame mother set IS dft-validation.extxyz (hidden E/F + RDF reference)

note: The 140-frame held-out in the reproduction is the EXPERT's internal split and must not be leaked to the agent. Because the public input is only the unrelaxed initial structure, the expert's 190-frame AIMD mother set is used wholesale as the hidden scientific reference (dft-validation.extxyz): the agent generates its own AIMD and can never train on the expert frames.
